building.heading: Building
building.paragraph1: The building has a total area of 12,697 m² and provides 617 beds. Rooms come in two layouts — block-style and corridor-style — with different levels of comfort and floor plans.
building.paragraph2: The building underwent a major renovation in 2014, and a video surveillance system was installed for residents' safety.
building.paragraph3: The building has two wings, laid out differently. On every floor of the right wing there are two kitchens, three shower rooms, four lounges for relaxing and socializing, and a separate room for washing and drying laundry. The left wing has one kitchen per floor, with showers made private within each block for more privacy.
building.paragraph4: Every room already has the necessary furniture — beds, wardrobes, nightstands, and a refrigerator. Students usually bring their own irons, hairdryers, and other small appliances. With the administrator's permission, you can adjust the room to your liking: add an extra wardrobe, put up shelves, or lay down a rug.

accessibility.heading: Accessibility for people with disabilities
accessibility.item1: The dormitory is equipped for residents with disabilities
accessibility.item3: The first floor has living rooms, a reading room, and restrooms for people with disabilities

directions.heading: Getting there
directions.item2: From "Aviamotornaya" metro — bus No. 695 or s679 to the "Andronovskoe Shosse, 26" stop, then on foot
directions.item3: From the main campus building (22 Radio St.) — bus No. 624 from the "Lefortovskaya Naberezhnaya" stop to "NII Prikladnoy Mekhaniki", then on foot
directions.item4: From the main campus building to "Aviamotornaya" metro — tram T2 or 50 from the "Lefortovskaya Naberezhnaya" stop

payment.heading: Payment
payment.paragraph1: Payment is made monthly, or upfront for a quarter or half-year, no later than the 5th of the billing month — the deadline is set in the housing contract.
payment.paragraph2: If payment is not received on time, starting on the 10th of the month following the billing period, a penalty begins to accrue — 0.14% per day of the outstanding amount (contract clauses 4.8/5.9).
payment.paragraph3: Correspondence-program students move in for the duration of their exam session, subject to availability — the cost is calculated by the actual number of days lived there.

polyclinic.heading: Registering with a clinic
polyclinic.intro: Students from other cities can register with the nearest clinic by presenting a passport, student ID, mandatory health insurance policy, and temporary registration.
polyclinic.step2: Bring your health insurance policy, passport, and SNILS
polyclinic.step3: Visit the nearest branch of the insurance company
